title: test(cli,showcase): two nightly-tier tests read the product as merged: the R5 field group, and no stage strip

## 维护者速读

- 用户无感:只改了两份测试,产品本身一行没动,夜间测试恢复全绿。
- 为什么做:近期两次已合并的改版(记录页去掉阶段条、明细行改由父对象字段分组内嵌)让两份测试过时,夜间测试在主干上持续报红。
- 出错会怎样:最坏是测试漏掉某个记录页回归;改动只在测试里,可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

Two tests lag merges that changed the product on purpose. The product is not touched; each test now reads what the product draws today.

**`packages/cli/test/lint-strict-warnings.e2e.test.ts`.** Since the change that made a parent field group, not the FK's `inlineEdit`, satisfy `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` (R5, `packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts`), the `clean` fixture drew one suggestion and `total` was 1. The fixture's `adviseMaster` knob now also gives the parent invoice a field group that places the line (`fieldGroups: [{ key: 'lines', label: 'Lines', relatedList: 'NS_line' }]`). `inlineEdit: true` stays: it still picks the form factor, and is spec-legal. The `stack()` doc comment says which two suggestions `adviseMaster: false` produces now. Every row of the header table was re-measured on this branch (`os lint --json` on each generated fixture); no row moved:

| fixture | errors | warnings | suggestions | rules (measured) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| warns | 0 | 2 | 0 | `protocol/missing-engines-range`, `relationship/master-detail-required` |
| suggests | 0 | 0 | 2 | `relationship/delete-behavior`, `relationship/line-items-inline-edit` |
| errs | 1 | 1 | 0 | `list-view-field-unknown`, `protocol/missing-engines-range` |
| clean | 0 | 0 | 0 | none |

**`examples/app-showcase/e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`.** The default record page no longer draws the `Record path` stage strip or the `Record highlights` key-field strip. The stage now shows as the header tag `data-record-stage-tag=FIELD`, and highlighted fields stay in their groups. The record page also has a tab row (`data-record-tab=ID`) and the 概览 rail (`RecordSummaryRail`). Each check was verified against the ui source and a real run:

- **grouped (zoo):** the stage-strip wait is replaced by the header tag reading `Active` (from `stageField: 'status'`), and both strips are asserted absent. Highlighted members stay in their groups: Status is in Basics, and amount `4,200` is hidden with Budget inside the collapsed Money group, then visible once it is opened. Group icon, description and the `$` currency checks are unchanged. **Dropped:** "the strip does not repeat the record title". The strip it tested no longer exists.
- **stageField:false (legacy zoo):** "no stepper" becomes "no stage tag at all", and the stepper and strip stay asserted absent.
- **related-heavy (Contoso):** renamed from "ungrouped + related-heavy". The stage tag replaces the stepper. The tab row opens on `overview`. The `relatedList: 'primary'` lists (Invoices, Projects) are body tables with no tab of their own, and a new positive control (`showcase_contact.account` tab present) shows that this absence check uses a real id. The Contacts rail card reads Carl Fox through `[data-record-summary-row]`, and the footer and `$25,000,000` checks remain (now scoped to the details). **Dropped:** "no tier draws a tab strip", which the tab row made false; "动态 is the last right-column panel (`data-record-timeline-panel`)", because the rail has no such panel (its activity card is hidden when there is no activity); and the "ungrouped / Contoso declares no fieldGroups / Basics count 0" shape, because `showcase_account` now declares fieldGroups and it is replaced by "its Profile group renders".

## Tests

<details><summary>CLI e2e: red on main, green on the branch</summary>

`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/lint-strict-warnings.e2e.test.ts`

On main (`141a826f` file):
```
 FAIL  |integration| test/lint-strict-warnings.e2e.test.ts > ... > a clean stack exits 0 under --strict, in both faces
AssertionError: the control is vacuous unless the stack is really clean: expected 1 to be +0
      Tests  1 failed | 7 passed (8)
```
On the branch:
```
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  8 passed (8)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 0
```
</details>

<details><summary>Showcase live tier: red on main, green on the branch</summary>

Run the way the nightly shard runs it: build the showcase dependency closure, `pnpm console:build`, then `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase test` (`showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` spawns `playwright test` against a real `serve --dev` backend). One difference from CI: Chromium is the preinstalled `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium` via `OS_TEST_CHROMIUM_EXECUTABLE_PATH`, not `playwright install --with-deps`.

On main (`141a826f` spec, `playwright test e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts`, CI=1):
```
  ✘  [chromium] › e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:95:5 › grouped: fieldGroup sections render and Money starts collapsed (retry #1)
  ✓  [chromium] › e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:146:5 › stageField:false: status renders as a plain field, no stepper
  ✘  [chromium] › e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:161:5 › ungrouped + related-heavy: flat details and the related panels on Contoso (retry #1)
    Locator: locator('[aria-label="Record path"]').first()
  2 failed
  1 passed
```
On the branch (`391fd92c`), the nightly command:
```
  ✓   2 [chromium] › e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:101:5 › grouped: fieldGroup sections render and Money starts collapsed (4.7s)
  ✓   3 [chromium] › e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:151:5 › stageField:false: status renders as a plain field, no stage tag (4.1s)
  ✓   4 [chromium] › e2e/detail-shapes.spec.ts:169:5 › related-heavy: body tables, the tab row and the rail on Contoso (6.2s)
  56 passed (3.1m)
```
`showcase-smoke.live.test.ts` passed. In the same package run, the other live file, `console-live-specs.live.test.ts`, failed on 4 line-item-grid specs outside this diff (see Acceptance notes).
</details>

Typecheck: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exits 0 (both tsconfigs include the edited files: the showcase `e2e/**/*`, the CLI `tsconfig.test.json` through `check:test-typecheck`).

## Acceptance notes

- In the same nightly-style package run, `test/console-live-specs.live.test.ts` failed 4 of 28 Console live specs: `form-view-subforms`, `grid-conditional-rules`, `grid-file-upload` and `grid-parent-rules`. They wait for a first line-item row input (`getByTestId('line-items') input[aria-label="Qty"]`) that never appears. On run 44871440181 (`98b3f87e`) that file passed, so these failures arrived after it, in the line-grid changes that merged after it (the grid no longer draws a blank entry row; new lines start on the child's defaults). This diff does not touch them, and they will red the next nightly. They are reported to the seat for a card.
- No changeset: neither file ships (`@objectstack/cli` `files` is `dist`, README, CHANGELOG; the showcase is private), so this PR takes the `skip-changeset` label.

## Verification

Read first: the `related-heavy` hunk of `detail-shapes.spec.ts` (the largest rewrite, where the three dropped checks were), then the `stack()` fixture in `lint-strict-warnings.e2e.test.ts`.

Two-minute check: `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run test/lint-strict-warnings.e2e.test.ts` should print `Tests 8 passed (8)`.
